column3: by bees of honey from Mukunda's face (fragment)
sorrow by bees of honey from Mukunda's face
on seeing Mukunda's image and abode
by hearing, reciting, contemplating Mukunda's glorious stories
from company of Mukunda, hard to leave even half a moment
by service of Mukunda's feet alone
with hair loose, without upper cloth
should roam here free from attachment
liberation desired by those free from attachment
freed from sons' breasts, not thinking of the cause
with pearl strings, banners, canopies, beds and seats
with strings of pearls as furnishings
a liberated, free from blindness, is very rare
with canopies of pearls, jewelled gold banners
covered with canopies of pearls, jewelled gold banners, various flags and balconies
having abandoned maya of the Self
from the mouth grazing, eating mouthfuls
from the mouth, from the eyes Atri, Marichi from the mind
split the enemy from the mouth
nests in the lotus face, Vedic birds, the sages
born of mouth, arms, thighs, feet
changes of the face and so on
demons, their splendour struck by smoke of breath-fire from mouth
Vajra was born from the mouth
eyes alarmed by buzzing of bees drawn to the fragrance of the face
like a bewildered, frightened one, drew near
hereafter it will be spread out
bathed in water of joyful tears
by sign, the nature of the act of the object
the sages in the ocean waters
in the assembly crowded with hosts of sages and best kings
by hosts of sages, eyes bewildered and rolling with constant intoxicating joy
sages, charanas, lords of beings, Vidyadharas, brahmanas and cows
by sages, unattached, to be honoured with respect
carried by sages with softened hearts
the sage should go to the sages' world easily here
the sage wishing to speak, the Lord
proclaimed by the best of sages
the sage desiring to see him
of the sage living in solitude
of the sage Yama's world cast off
of the liberation seeker, wishing to cross
fainted as if by divine maya
by ten thousand terrible strong nooses of Mura
of the enemy of Mura, other here
described the deeds of Murari, of nectar fame
in the strike of the pestle
Mushtika, Chanura, Shala, Toshalaka and others
by Mushtika, Arishta, Dvivida, Putana, Keshin, Dhenuka
stealing one another's slings and so on
repeatedly in the flood of water
repeatedly most worthy of honour to us following the path
will cause to cry out repeatedly
repeatedly, bad company, pitiable, no mind peace
repeatedly heard, the following mind of him
repeatedly in the three tracks did he become a refuge
for a moment he was silent
knowing the span of life a moment, having come
half a moment with unblunted sight
half a moment with unblunted sight, having pierced
at the Abhijit moment, the Lord
deluded women, delight with the nectar of lips
is deluded in the ocean of ignorance
fool, deeply immersed in your maya
by a fool who knows the forbidden act
embodiments bearing weapons on the back (?)
embodiment of dharma, the Self guest
on the top of the head
on head, by the destroyer of sin
on head, thousand heads like atoms
on the head, with golden vessels
climbed to the head by the feet
by one appointed at the head
on the head, to dispel sin
only the ending of being a deer
mother dead from fear of the lion
the one seeking, the leader invited
deer, camels, donkeys, bears, rats, reptiles, birds, flies
I wipe off the dust of the Self
wiping off pain of the road
in assemblies of Shiva and Brahma
white as lotus-fibre, long serpent coils
white as lotus-fibre, long serpent coil couch
remembering dead birth, like others attained deer body
took the dead mother to the hermitage
as if come from the dead
coming and going of the dead
bringing back the dead elder brothers
from fear of the elephant of death, in darkness
(they) obtain death, those who do not know that
death, from the foolish, not wise
death, nine states of the body
death by the gods who have Vaikuntha as refuge
death not in dry or wet
death of the lord of Bhojas, of the ignorant, cosmic
afraid of the python of death
by the Self, not perishing, from death
of death, who devour with stomach fire
song with mridanga, panava, anaka instruments
with mridanga, panava, anaka instruments, songs, flower offerings and praises
with mridanga, drums, anaka, conch, cow-horn trumpets
with sounds of mridanga, vina, muraja, flute, cymbal, conch
with mridanga, conch, drums, vina, panava, cow-horn
mridanga, conch, panava, dhundhuri, anaka, cow-horn instruments
with sounds of mridanga, conch, anaka, kettledrums
soft, hard, light, heavy, hot, cold
with clay, wood, iron, gold, kusha, skin
vessels set out of clay, wood, iron, gold, kusha, skin
enduring, went out from within the water
with pure-souled, new silks, ornaments, garlands
girdle, deerskin, staff, rosary, sacred thread, water pot
offered to me by the Self
to me, not on other objects
to me, they two do wrong
Meru, long as an island, steep
four sides of Meru, supporting mountains
daughters of Meru and other mountains
with urine, spittle, stones, dung, dust-throwing, foul winds, harsh words
O friend of the afflicted, with friendly look
giver of the state of liberation
I will release, the path of meaning
swans and ducks maddened with joy and pleasure (fragment)
with honey of joy and wine
